build_self_supervision_task: build a SelfSupervisionTask from a yaml config to prepare optimizer, datasets, dataloaders, losses, and meters for training
prepare_training_pipeline: prepare the full training pipeline including model, optimizer, loss, meters, and dataloaders from a config
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a checkpoint by restoring model state, optimizer state, amp state, and data iterators
prepare_feature_extraction: prepare a lightweight task for feature extraction on multi-gpu with the model running in eval mode only
create_ema_model: create an exponential moving average model copy for training with configurable decay and device placement
